name: vuln-lens
description: Security review for Python: deterministic CWE rules plus optional AI verification through Ollama, your own API key, or GitHub Copilot.

commands.title: VulnLens: Analyze Current File with AI

vulnLens.scanOnOpen.description: Scan Python files when they are opened.

vulnLens.scanOnSave.description: Scan Python files when they are saved.

vulnLens.ai.mode.markdownDescription: Which backend verifies rule findings. `off` keeps VulnLens fully offline. Note: `byok`, `ollama`, and `copilot` send the analysed function to that provider.

vulnLens.ai.analyzeOnSave.description: Run AI verification on save for functions that triggered a rule. Requires vulnLens.ai.mode.

vulnLens.ai.deepScan.markdownDescription: When set, `VulnLens: Analyze Current File with AI` also sends functions that no rule flagged. Costs more requests; useful for measuring what the rules miss.

vulnLens.ai.minConfidence.description: Minimum model confidence before a rule finding is marked as a likely false positive.

vulnLens.ai.maxChunks.description: Safety cap on how many functions a single file may send.

vulnLens.localModel.enabled.markdownDescription: Run a local ONNX CodeBERT classifier to triage functions before AI verification. Requires a model exported by `ml/kaggle/export_onnx.py` and `npm install onnxruntime-node` in the extension folder. The model never creates findings on its own; it only proposes functions for the AI verifier.

vulnLens.localModel.path.description: Directory containing model.onnx, vocab.json and merges.txt.

vulnLens.localModel.threshold.description: P(vulnerable) above which a function no rule flagged is sent to the AI verifier.

vulnLens.localModel.maxChunks.description: Maximum functions the local model scores per file.

vulnLens.localModel.timeoutMs.description: Per-function inference timeout. A timed-out worker is replaced.

vulnLens.byok.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Any OpenAI-compatible base URL (OpenAI, Groq, Together, OpenRouter, LM Studio).

vulnLens.byok.model.description: Model name for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.eval: node eval/extract-labels.mjs && npm run compile && node dist/eval.js
scripts.eval:ai: node eval/extract-labels.mjs && npm run compile && node dist/eval.js --modes rules,ollama,deep
scripts.eval:model: node eval/extract-labels.mjs && npm run compile && node dist/eval-model.js
